snippet.title: Gameplay of Shanwen: Chinese Mystery Story
snippet.description:
New gameplay clip from Shanwen, a story-driven mystery game with a unique Chinese folk atmosphere.
The demo is now available, so feel free to try it out!
If you enjoy slow-burn storytelling and atmospheric exploration, wishlist and follow for more updates.
